hooks.name: SDLC stage gate
hooks.description: Blocks writes to source files until the AI-Native SDLC artifact chain (intent.md -> spec.md -> plan.md) is accepted for the slug named in .sdlc/active. Artifacts, evals, .github and .sdlc stay writable so a change can be started. Inert in a repo with no .sdlc/ directory. The command self-disables (exit 0) when python3 or the gate script cannot be found: under Kiro's contract ANY non-zero exit blocks the tool, so an infrastructure problem must never brick every write.

action.command: sh -c 'for g in ".sdlc/scripts/sdlc_pretooluse_hook.py" "$HOME/.claude/skills/ai-native-sdlc/scripts/sdlc_pretooluse_hook.py" "$HOME/.kiro/skills/ai-native-sdlc/scripts/sdlc_pretooluse_hook.py" "$HOME/.kiro/crew/skills/ai-native-sdlc/scripts/sdlc_pretooluse_hook.py"; do [ -f "$g" ] && break; g=""; done; [ -n "$g" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$g"'
